instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot. Inside an indoor boxing gym with a blue mat floor, the man in the gray t-shirt (R1) stands on the left in a defensive boxing stance, smiling warmly at his partner. Facing him on the right, the woman in the blue hoodie (R2) wears pink boxing gloves and throws a punch toward him. A red punching bag hangs between them in the background, and another red bag is visible on the far left. Bright overhead gym lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the blue floor.
